label: H.R. 3383
title: Incentivizing New Ventures and Economic Strength Through Capital Formation Act of 2025
short_title: Incentivizing New Ventures and Economic Strength Through Capital Formation Act of 2025

latest_action.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs.

summary: Increasing Investor Opportunities Act This bill allows a closed-end fund—a portfolio of pooled assets with a limited number of shares traded on an exchange—to increase its investment in private investment funds. Specifically, the Securities and Exchange Commission is prohibited from limiting the sale or listing of securities of a closed-end fund that invests in private investment funds. This bill also apples to a closed-end company treated as a business development company.
summary_short: Increasing Investor Opportunities Act This bill allows a closed-end fund—a portfolio of pooled assets with a limited number of shares traded on an exchange—to increase its investment in private investment funds.
